Fina’s friend Vivid is here too. Fina is about to set out: her mother Silba has been missing for a year. She wants to become a Crystal Elf like her mother and hopes to find a trace of her in Sky City. Before leaving home, she speaks with Vivid and Colorida and says goodbye.

Colorida hat Fina eine Empfehlung für Me: Colorida has given Fina a recommendation for Mistress Aria, who teaches the Crystal Elves in Sky City. Fina leaves her friend Vivid and the familiar paint cauldrons behind. She wants to learn to protect others, and is also searching for her mother Silba, missing for a year.
Cirrus hat Fina den Weg bis zur Rufplatt: Cirrus has shown Fina the way to the calling platform. Sky City lies beyond the gap; she cannot reach it on foot from here. Her bag contains two different crystals: Silba’s keepsake crystal and Fina’s own decorative crystal.
The call has reached a cloud glider. Kian is a flyer with mechanical wings, not a sailing ship. His wings will carry him and Fina over the broken cloud road. Fina has never been a passenger on such a flight.
Kian hat Fina auf einer anderen Wolkenst: Kian has dropped Fina on another cloud road. The starting place is behind her now. From here, she must walk on to Sky City. An unexpected buzz interrupts her thoughts of Aria and Silba.
Fina und ihre neue Reisebegleiterin Muck: Fina and her new travelling companion Muck follow the cloud road towards the city. Workers here wear black tops, orange trousers and colourful headscarves. They catch fine windblown sand with round sieves. Fina wants to understand what sand has to do with a city of ice and clouds.
Coloridas Empfehlung soll Aria zeigen, w: Colorida’s recommendation should tell Aria where Fina comes from and why she wants to become a Crystal Elf. Fina therefore keeps it carefully. H and O stand at the gate. Before looking for Aria, she must speak with these two rain guards.
H und O haben Coloridas Schreiben mit Wa: H and O have poured water over Colorida’s letter. The ink has run and the paper is soaked. Rather than apologise, the two have fled into the city. Fina follows angrily; Muck stays with her.
Auf der Suche nach den Regenwachen ist F: While looking for the rain guards, Fina collided with Cold, who expects her for a duel at midday light in Cloud Grove. Fina continues her search. The next alley is full of fabrics and long coats, with little space between stalls.
Auch Powdery hat Fina zu einem Duell im: Powdery has challenged Fina to a duel in Cloud Grove too, shortly after midday light. Fina wanted to confront H and O, but hurt others in her haste. At this quieter reading place, she hears an elf reading aloud. She is still trying to find the guards’ trail.
Fina hat drei Verabredungen im Wolkenhai: Fina has three appointments in Cloud Grove: Icy before midday light, Cold at midday light and Powdery afterwards. On the way there, she hears the bell of the snow sluices. Here she can see what the Crystal Elves work for.
Chrysta hat Fina den Weg zum Wolkenhain: Chrysta has shown Fina the way to Cloud Grove. The three elves she upset while searching for H and O wait there. Fina has come for the agreed duels. She wishes her first day in the city had started differently.
Cold, Powdery und Icy begleiten Fina nac: Cold, Powdery and Icy accompany Fina to Mistress Aria after the attack in Cloud Grove. The four defended themselves against the guards together. Fina felt magic within her. Now she wants to learn to use it responsibly.
Diese Szene zeigt einen anderen Ort. Fin: This scene shows another place. Fina and her friends are not here. Lord Regis, the Rain Lord, speaks with 2, a small figure with that unusual name. The player hears a conversation Fina knows nothing about.
Die Kristallfee regiert die Himmelsstadt: The Crystal Fairy rules Sky City. Little Funkel serves at her side. Lord Regis is the Rain Lord; water and ice both belong to this world. Fina is not in the throne room and cannot witness what happens next.
Fina ist inzwischen Arias Anwärterin. Co: Fina is now Aria’s apprentice. Cold, Powdery and Icy have accepted her and want to show her the city. Funkel approaches along their route. Fina does not yet know the queen’s little servant personally.
Funkel hat berichtet, dass Regis die Kri: Funkel has reported that Regis turned the Crystal Fairy into living water. The queen lives but is trapped. The four elves and Muck want to rescue her. Mist Guards block the direct way, so they seek a route through the workshops.
Cold ist in Chrystels Werkstatt gebliebe: Cold stayed in Chrystel’s workshop to hold back the guards. Fina continues with Powdery, Icy and Muck. Chrystel sent them to Christi with a checked snowflake model. Christi works with light and cloud maps.
Christi hat den verborgenen Kartengang g: Christi opened the hidden map passage and explained the route. Powdery protects it from the guards and stays behind. Fina, Icy and Muck continue searching for the water dungeon. Fina now worries about two friends.
Icy hat Fina den letzten Weg erklärt und: Icy showed Fina the final route and held back the attacking guards. Fina and Muck have reached the water dungeon through the silver-bound door. The transformed elves are meant to be imprisoned here. Silba is still missing.
Fina hat ein leuchtendes Gefäß ohne Kris: Fina found a glowing vessel without a crystal pendant. She carries Silba’s crystal herself. Before she can learn more, guards arrive. Fina and Muck hide behind a pillar. H, O and 2 enter with prisoners.
H, 2 und O haben sich gegen Regis entsch: H, 2 and O have turned against Regis. They don’t want ice and snow to disappear from their world. Cold, Powdery and Icy are unbound and stand beside Fina again. Silba and the queen remain trapped as water.
Silba und die Kristallfee haben ihre Ges: Silba and the Crystal Fairy have regained their forms. The other prisoners are free too. Fina can finally see her mother again — but footsteps sound on the stairs. Regis has not been stopped.
Muck hat Regis trotz ihrer Abneigung geg: Despite disliking water, Muck has stopped Regis. The Mist Guards now guard him in the ice dungeon. The queen is free and calls the helpers to the throne room. For the first time since the attack, they can speak without being pursued.
Fina ist zur Eisklinge ernannt worden un: Fina has become an Ice Blade, joining Cold, Powdery and Icy. Silba is with her again. Muck and H2O have been honoured for their help. Now the friends can talk about their experiences and their home in Colour Spring.
